newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle trade slow at $67- feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle trade slow at $67- feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sales were slow near midday Friday, with $67.00 per cwt paid, steady with Thursday, but down $1.00 from Wednesday's top price, feedlot sources said.
About 300 head sold in Kansas and about 800 in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area, sources there said.

Most of the showlist in the Panhandle was sold this week as was a large portion of the showlist in Kansas, they said. The Panhandle's showlist earlier in the week was estimated near 100,000 head and the Kansas showlist was pegged near 82,000.
